name: Motorenwerk Saalach GmbH

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 18 of 19 invoices paid >3 days late, max 40 days. Our worst record: avg 19.3 days late, 18 of 19 invoices late, max 40 days; it complained in writing.

financial_health.signal: Group, credit 171 unchanged; healthy but disengaging from us.

notes: Asks 2.4-3.9%, settles ~3 pp lower (EV-2026-70580-350013: asked 3.3, settled 1.7).

situation: Motor maker (EUR 182 m), sole active source of the 30 kW IE4 motor (EUR 1,608.32). It is refocusing on large key accounts; its new sales director calls our volumes 'not strategic', replies slow down, and the latest quote is list price, stock only, valid 7 days. Its main grievance is us: we pay ~19 days late on 30-day terms and it warned it will review conditions. Quality is now excellent (OTD 95.8%, 0 ppm).

pressures.evidence: Overdue invoices complaint; we pay 19 days late on average.
Refocus on key accounts; Hollerau 'not strategic'.

likely_tradeables.give: firm on-time payment, even 30 days honoured or faster
likely_tradeables.get: price hold / renewal at current price, normal validity
likely_tradeables.why: fixes its main complaint at near-zero cost to us

arguments_that_should_land.argument: We will pay strictly on the agreed date from now on.
Nordmark is qualified on the 30 kW (quoted EUR 1,495.59 in 2024).
arguments_that_should_land.why: credible alternative; cite only if Nordmark quote is in the case

arguments_to_avoid.argument: Complaining about slow replies or demanding discounts
arguments_to_avoid.why: we are the late payer; tone backfires

key_quotes.quote: We ask you to keep to the agreed payment terms; otherwise we will have to review our conditions.
